thread:
Liz: quick check — we're planning to deprecate /api/v1/chat on 2025-07-15. Need final owners for gateway shim, SDK adapter, and docs. Who's taking what? :calendar:

Mike: I can own the gateway shim + backward-compat layer. ETA for canary? Need socket compatibility tests and a small perf run. :nerd_face:

Anita: I'll own SDK adapters (py/ts). PR skeleton done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482. Will need changelog copy from docs and a migration example for streaming clients.

Kevin: I'll handle docs + migration guide and Console banner. Can we get a concrete list of breaking param renames and example curl calls? I want to stage the guide with code blocks.

Liz: breaking params — we remove `stream=old` flag, rename `model_id` -> `model`, and response field `tokens` -> `generated_tokens`. Example payloads:```json
{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"translate: hello"}
``` Will push a full diff to docs repo today.

Mike: ack. On the gateway I'm going to add a compatibility header `X-V2-Compat: true` that maps v1 keys to v2 at the edge. That adds ~2-5ms at p50 from our perf runs — acceptable?

Anita: To avoid the runtime hit for most customers, SDK will ship an adapter that sets the header and does client-side mapping. Plan: release 1.3.0 as opt-in (adapter behind flag), then 1.4.0 make it default + deprecate v1 helpers.

Kevin: docs note: include a section comparing latency with/without gateway shim. Liz — can you add a short blurb for the Console banner so I can reuse it verbatim?

Liz: Draft banner text: "Legacy v1 endpoints will be removed on Jul 15, 2025. See migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate-v1-to-v2". I'll open a docs PR by EOD. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment triggered: canary-gateway-v2-compat started at 1754322800. Status: rolling.

Mike: Canary logs look ok overall. Seeing a header mapping error with long prompts (>64k chars) — filing issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/issues/221. We'll add a fix and retry canary.

Anita: I'll add a unit test for the mapping and a small e2e run in the SDK CI matrix that hits the canary host. ETA for tests: tomorrow morning.

Kevin: Summary / owners: gateway -> Mike, SDK -> Anita, docs/Console -> Kevin, overall PM/comms -> Liz. I'll draft the cross-team notice and schedule the deprecation announcement for Monday. :mailbox_with_mail:

Liz: thanks all — please drop any migration snippets or gotchas into the docs PR, and ping here when the SDK PR is ready so we can coordinate the canary flip. :thumbsup:
